subject: Promo credit approval & chargeback / invoice-offset routing
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@cloudcanvas.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudCanvas Billing <billing@cloudcanvas.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: promotional trial credits + 30-day extension - accounting treatment?

Hi Hannah / Laura,

Thanks for taking this. We ran a small pilot with Redwood for a group of enterprise customers and would like to extend three pilot accounts by 30 days and apply promotional credits to cover any overages. Summary: 
- Total promo credit pool: $12,000 (aggregate across 3 tenants)
- Trial extension requested: +30 days from 2025-09-01
- Contracts: CloudCanvas-ENT-2025-07 (primary)

Ask: Can you confirm whether Redwood will:
1) issue customer credit memos (CCMs) applied as invoice offsets, or
2) post a contra revenue allowance (promotional expense) and leave invoices as-is with a separate refund/credit process?

We also need guidance on whether the credits should be applied to the Aug invoice (closing 8/31) or posted as a September adjustment. Our billing team prefers invoice-offsets to avoid manual refunds, but procurement needs the audit trail for recognition.

Attaching the pilot terms and a spreadsheet with the tenant breakdown.

Attachments: promo_terms.pdf, tenant-breakdown.csv (attached to billing thread)

If you need the PO/contract redlines, Marta (cc'd on procurement) can provide. Looking for a path that avoids revenue recognition issues on your side.

Best,
Olivia
Director, Strategic Accounts, CloudCanvas

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@cloudcanvas.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Aug 2025 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: promotional trial credits + 30-day extension - accounting treatment?

Thanks Olivia — looping in Marcus (finance) and Laura (sales ops) to confirm the accounting flow. Quick intake so we can get you a final answer:
- Confirming the $12,000 is a promotional allowance tied to a defined promo period and not considered customer-funded credit.
- Is CloudCanvas acting as an end-customer or as a reseller for any of the three tenants? (If reseller, chargeback flow applies.)

Preliminary options for us:
A) Issue customer credit memos against August invoices (invoice-offset) — preferred operationally, posts as reduction to billed revenue for the month the invoice is offset.
B) Post as contra revenue / promotional allowance and process a separate refund/credit note in September — preserves August invoicing history but requires separate journal entry and disclosure.

Marcus — can you look at GLA mapping and whether we need a contra reserve in ASC 606 terms if the extension changes performance obligations? I attached an approval matrix for us to complete (approval-matrix.xlsx).

Next steps: Marcus to recommend; Laura to confirm any SOW/contract implications; Hannah to confirm with Olivia which approach works operationally.

Hannah
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@cloudcanvas.com>, CloudCanvas Billing <billing@cloudcanvas.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Sep 2025 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: promotional trial credits + 30-day extension - accounting treatment?

On Sat, Aug 30, 2025 at 9:12 AM Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@cloudcanvas.com> wrote:
> Thanks for taking this. We ran a small pilot...

Hi all — finance review below. TL;DR: We can do invoice-offset credit memos for operational simplicity; provide us the invoice numbers and we'll apply CCMs net of any sales tax. If CloudCanvas is reselling to end-customers, we need a partner chargeback and a separate intercompany billing flow. 

Accounting guidance: 
- Recommended path: Issue Customer Credit Memo(s) applied to target invoices (Option A). This reduces revenue in the period the invoice is offset. GLA impact: credit against Revenue - Product (GLA 4102).
- Alternative: Record a promotional contra revenue reserve (GLA 5209) if the credit is uncertain or spans multiple reporting periods. Use this if the credit is not tied to a specific invoice or if recognition criteria require a reserve.

Journal sample (invoice-offset):
  Dr Accounts Receivable (invoice)  $12,000
  Cr Revenue - Product (GLA 4102)   $12,000

Journal sample (contra reserve approach):
  Dr Marketing/Promotion Expense (GLA 6501) $12,000
  Cr Promotion Reserve (GLA 5209)           $12,000
  // reserve reversal when credit applied

Operational notes: 
- For invoice-offsets, we need: invoice numbers + invoice dates + tax details.
- For chargebacks (if reseller): provide partner contract id and the desired recipient of the chargeback. We'll route to partner-billing.

I attached a sample CCM template we use for vendor billing (CCM_CloudCanvas_0819.pdf). If you want us to backdate to Aug 31, we can do so but it will affect August revenue (FYI for your accounting).

Hannah/Laura — once you confirm which route, finance will prepare the CCMs and notify CloudCanvas billing with the posting date and reference.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Manager, Revenue Accounting
Redwood Inference
